title: Platform in the Snowmelt
brief: Original instrumental ballad in the manner of an anime ending theme. Piano and strings carry it; it opens quietly on solo piano and the last chorus is the fullest moment. D-flat major, last chorus a half step up in D. The piano sings the verses, a solo violin the choruses, a solo cello the bridge.

sections.intent: Solo piano, soft: the chorus hook high and sparse over IV-V-iii-vi-ii-V; nothing else plays
A-melo: piano melody low and conversational over a tonic pedal; cellos and violas enter pp in bar 9
B-melo: rising sequence by thirds, faster harmonic rhythm, strings enter one by one, half cadence
Sabi: solo violin takes the hook an octave above the verse; piano eighth chords, strings, bass; no drums
Post-chorus: the hook on piano doubled by a bell an octave up; strings hold
Verse again with the band: bass and a light kit (side-stick), violin descant from bar 37
Build again, fuller: pad enters, rising violins, drum fill and a breath before the chorus
Chorus with full kit and a cello-section countermelody under the violin
C-melo in B-flat minor: solo cello leads, horn and strings build from bar 61 to a cut-off
Ochi-sabi: the hook almost alone on piano, an octave low; bar 68 swells on A7 toward the new key
Last chorus a half step up in D: hook in unison and octaves, horn, full kit; deceptive cadence, bVI-bVII lift to the peak (D6 held, E6), arrival on D
Solo piano: the intro phrase in D, ringing out on D(add9)

authorship: Every note written by compose.py (music-production 0.3.0 example jp_ballad).
decisions: Lead plan: piano (verses, pre-choruses, ochi-sabi, outro), solo violin (choruses), solo cello (bridge).
Last chorus a half step up (D-flat to D), approached from B-flat minor 7 by A7sus4 a semitone below it.
High point bar 78: the melody holds D6 over B-flat major 7 (bVI, chromatic mediant), then E6 over C (bVII), and a 4-3 suspension on A7sus4 resolves into D in bar 80.
Drums held back until verse 2; the horn and timpani only in the bridge build and the last chorus.

revision_history.note: First full draft after score-review fixes (review_r0 -> review_r1).
Mix: violin +2.5 dB, violins I -1.5, cellos -1, piano -1, solo cello +1; piano widths 0.4/0.7; piano melody +2.5 dB in pre-chorus 2 and the outro (analyze_r1 lead presence and correlation).
Sound: the music-box doubling moves from the curated music_box to rare_earth/plucks/music_box (audition_bell: 92% vs 9.7% of its power above 2 kHz).

Outro balance (analyze_r3: the outro melody group 8.7 dB under the rest): the held D6 of the last chorus (violin, violins I and II) and the horn/viola F#4 now end on the downbeat of the outro; outro strings 8 steps softer.

Performance fix (found in analyze_r4: outro strings at velocity 101-104): every note on the first downbeat of a section took the closing level of the section before (the ochi-sabi bass note at 100 instead of 40, the outro strings at about 104 instead of 38); they now take the level of their own section.

Voice leading (review_r4/r5: 14 parallel fifths and octaves, most between the cello roots and the inner string voices in the pre-choruses): each offending inner-voice note (violas, violins II, violins I where they hold harmony) moves to the nearest chord tone that makes no parallel, no minor second or ninth and no unison with the other string parts.
